Project EDA

Author

Cathy C.

Modified

March 9, 2025

Load packages

pacman::p_load(ggplot2, tidyverse, ggthemes, dplyr, tidyr, knitr)

Import file

g2b_data <- read_csv("data/GovBIZ.csv")

EDA

1 Check missing values

There is no missing values. Award date is character form, so need to change to date.

summary(g2b_data)

2 Number of agencies, suppliers

agency_count <- length(unique(g2b_data$agency))
supplier_count <- length(unique(g2b_data$supplier_name))

print(paste("# agency: ", agency_count))

print(paste("# supplier: ", supplier_count))

3 Awards amount

3.1 Award amount in descending order (supplier)

library(dplyr)

desc_supp_award <- g2b_data %>%
  group_by(supplier_name) %>%
  summarise(total_award_amt = sum(awarded_amt, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_award_amt)) %>%
  ungroup()

3.5 Top 10 suppliers from top 10 agencies by award amount

top_agencies_award <- g2b_data %>%
  group_by(agency) %>%
  summarise(total_awarded_amt = sum(awarded_amt, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  slice_max(order_by = total_awarded_amt, n = 10)

#filter only the top 10 agencies and get top 10 suppliers for each
top_suppliers_award <- g2b_data %>%
  filter(agency %in% top_agencies_award$agency) %>%
  
  group_by(agency, supplier_name) %>%
  summarise(total_award_amt = sum(awarded_amt, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  
  group_by(agency) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = total_award_amt, n = 10) %>%
  mutate(total_award_amt_mil = round(total_award_amt / 1000000, 4)) %>%
  ungroup()

4.5 Top 10 supplies from top 10 agencies by tender count

top_agencies <- g2b_data %>%
  group_by(agency) %>%
  summarise(total_tenders = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(total_tenders)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  pull(agency)

# Get the top 10 suppliers for each of the top 10 agencies based on tender count
top_suppliers_per_agency <- g2b_data %>%
  filter(agency %in% top_agencies) %>%  
  group_by(agency, supplier_name) %>%
  summarise(tender_count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(agency, desc(tender_count)) %>%  
  group_by(agency) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%  # Select top 10 suppliers per agency
  ungroup()

# View result

6 By year

library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
g2b_data_backup <- g2b_data

# Convert award_date to Date and extract the year
g2b_data_backup$award_date <- dmy(g2b_data_backup$award_date)
g2b_data_backup$award_year <- year(g2b_data_backup$award_date)

# Check for missing dates and award_year values
missing_dates <- g2b_data_backup %>% filter(is.na(award_date))
missing_years <- g2b_data_backup %>% filter(is.na(award_year))
cat("Missing dates:", nrow(missing_dates), "\n")
Missing dates: 0 
cat("Missing award_years:", nrow(missing_years), "\n")
Missing award_years: 0 
# Ensure there are no missing values for the year column
if (nrow(missing_years) > 0) {
  print("Rows with missing years:")
  print(missing_years)
} else {
  # Get top 10 agencies by total tender count per year
  top_agencies <- g2b_data_backup %>%
    group_by(award_year, agency) %>%
    summarise(total_tenders = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(award_year, desc(total_tenders)) %>%
    group_by(award_year) %>%
    slice_head(n = 10)  # Select top 10 agencies per year

  # Get top 10 suppliers for each of the top 10 agencies per year by tender count
  top_suppliers_per_agency <- g2b_data_backup %>%
    inner_join(top_agencies, by = c("award_year", "agency")) %>% # Filter to top agencies per year
    group_by(award_year, agency, supplier_name) %>%
    summarise(total_tenders = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(award_year, agency, desc(total_tenders)) %>%
    group_by(award_year, agency) %>%
    slice_head(n = 10)  # Select top 10 suppliers per agency per year

  # Split data into a list of tables, one for each year
  tables_by_year <- top_suppliers_per_agency %>%
    group_by(award_year) %>%
    group_split()

  # Check the number of tables and the unique years again
  unique_years <- unique(top_suppliers_per_agency$award_year)
  cat("Length of tables_by_year:", length(tables_by_year), "\n")
  cat("Number of unique years:", length(unique_years), "\n")


  # Assign meaningful names to each table based on award_year
  if (length(tables_by_year) == length(unique_years)) {
    names(tables_by_year) <- as.character(unique_years)

    # Print each year's table
    for (year in names(tables_by_year)) {
      cat("\n\n### Top 10 Agencies & Suppliers for Year:", year, "\n")
      kable(tables_by_year[[year]])
    }
  } else {
    print("Mismatch between unique years and the number of tables")
  }
}
